subject: Cloudbridge listing — special pricing approval & procurement path
messages:
From: Maya Patel <maya.patel@cloudbridge.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Cloudbridge Procurement <procurement@cloudbridge.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: special marketplace pricing for Cloudbridge pilot

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the demo last week — the product looked great and the team is excited to move our pilot into a private-offer on AWS Marketplace. Procurement pushed back on list pricing and asked whether Redwood can provide a special marketplace price for the 12-month pilot (expected contract value $180k ARR annualized, ramping to $600k ARR in year two).

Cloudbridge is requesting a marketplace-discount (applied as a private offer) around 30% for year one to fit our procurement approval thresholds.

What do we need from Redwood to route this through your deal desk and marketplace ops? Procurement is on a tight deadline (need a signed private offer by next Friday, 9/17). Happy to share a redlined SOW if helpful.

Thanks — cc'ing procurement.

Best,
Maya Patel
Head of Cloud Partnerships
Cloudbridge

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Patel <maya.patel@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: Cloudbridge Procurement <procurement@cloudbridge.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: special marketplace pricing for Cloudbridge pilot

Hi Maya — thanks for the note and the urgency.

We can support a private-offer flow on AWS Marketplace, but a 30% discount will need an internal concession approval from Deal Desk + Marketplace Ops review (they verify listing & fee carveouts). I'm looping in Ben (Deals) and Laura (Marketplace Ops) to kick off the approval.

Ben/Laura/Vanessa — quick context below from Cloudbridge. Key asks: 30% off list for year one, 12-month pilot, target signing by 9/17. Expected ARR year1 ~$180k; long-term upside to $600k ARR. Procurement included on this thread.

Maya — can you confirm the billing entity for the private offer (Cloudbridge, Inc. or a different entity) and attach the SOW you mentioned? Procurement, please flag any additional compliance docs you require for private-offer acceptance.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2027 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Request: special marketplace pricing for Cloudbridge pilot

Jonas — thanks for the loop. 25-30% requests are common for early strategic pilots; we can approve but need to document concession and attach a reduced-rate pricing matrix for Marketplace billing.

Proposal (initial):
- Year 1 private-offer discount: 25% off published AWS Marketplace list for the specified SKUs
- Year 2: revert to standard list pricing with a 12-month notice; or step-up to a negotiated renewal discount depending on usage
- Marketplace fee carveout: Redwood will absorb standard marketplace listing fees for the duration of the pilot (to be confirmed by Ops)

Next steps for approval:
1) Finance sign-off on revenue recognition impact (cc'ing Finance in a follow-up if needed)
2) Laura to confirm ops feasibility and whether listing notes/fee carveouts are acceptable
3) Formal concession doc (I attached a one-pager and a pricing matrix) — please upload to HubSpot and tag deal RW-CLB-2027-042.

Attachments: [deal_summary.pdf (PDF, 324KB)], [pricing_matrix.xlsx (Excel, 28KB)]

Ben Carter
Director, Deal Desk, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2027 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Request: special marketplace pricing for Cloudbridge pilot

Thanks Ben — this looks reasonable. A couple of operational notes from Marketplace:

- We need a short "listing notes" doc that the AWS Marketplace team will review; it must call out the private-offer SKUs, the effective discount % and the start/end dates. I can draft that once we confirm the exact SKUs Cloudbridge will purchase.
- Fee carveouts: Ops can typically approve Redwood absorbing the first-party fees for a 12-month pilot, but we need legal to sign off on the carveout language in the private-offer (I will queue Legal).
- Timeline: if Cloudbridge needs a signed private offer by 9/17, we should target final concession sign-off by 9/13 to give Ops time to publish.

I've put a short set of notes together and attached them here: [marketplace_listing_notes.docx (DOCX, 15KB)]. Please review and confirm SKUs and billing entity so we can push to Ops.

Laura Bennett
Head of Marketplace Programs, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

Subject: Approved: Cloudbridge private-offer concession (next steps)

Maya / Procurement — good news: Deal Desk + Marketplace Ops have conditionally approved a concession for Cloudbridge. Summary of approved terms below: 

- Effective private-offer discount: 25% off published AWS Marketplace SKUs for months 1-12
- Redwood will absorb listing fees for the 12-month pilot (per Ops; legal will include carveout language in the DocuSign private-offer)
- Renewal: standard list pricing unless a renewal discount is negotiated during the last 90 days of the pilot

Attachments included for your records: [marketplace_listing_notes.docx], [deal_summary.pdf], [pricing_matrix.xlsx]

Next steps (to hit Cloudbridge procurement deadline 9/17):
1) Maya: confirm billing entity name for the private-offer (exact legal entity) and return the redlined SOW if any changes are required.
2) Procurement: once billing entity confirmed, we'll publish the private-offer and route DocuSign to the signee (link will be provided).
3) Ops/Legal: I will share final carveout language with Legal and confirm publish window today.

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567890 (RW-CLB-2027-042)
DocuSign (pending): https://www.docusign.com/sign/ABCDEF-Cloudbridge-PO
